name: Camp Hazen YMCA Overnight Camp
description_short: Overnight YMCA camp on Cedar Lake in Chester, CT, for campers entering grades 3 to 10. It offers one-week Sampler sessions and traditional two-week sessions. Campers live in cabins grouped into five age-based villages and choose four daily skill classes from water sports, land sports, outdoor pursuits and creative arts.
refund_policy_summary: Program fees are refunded, minus the deposit, if you cancel at least 30 days before the session starts. Deposits become non-refundable on January 1. There are no refunds for late arrival, early departure, homesickness, withdrawal, dismissal or sickness. Half of the remaining balance is due March 1 and the rest May 1. If final payment is late, the registration may be cancelled and the deposit kept.
special_needs_notes: An Individual Care Plan is required for campers with a special health care need or disability. Families can upload extra medical documents, such as a diabetes or asthma management plan. The kitchen can handle vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free diets and uses no peanuts or tree nuts. All medications must be checked in with the nurse, with an authorization form signed by both a parent and the prescriber. There are usually two to three RNs on site each session.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is in Cedar Lake, a 68-acre spring-fed lake that the town and the camp test independently. Campers take a swim evaluation on check-in day. Two-week campers who qualify as "Flying Fish" (YMCA Swim Program) skip swim lessons; all other campers take them, except one-week Sampler campers, who do not take lessons. Waterfront staff hold American Red Cross Lifeguarding and CPR certification.
